description: This script automates the process of generating SVG icon sprites and TypeScript icon name definitions for a web project. It reads SVG files, creates a sprite SVG with symbols, and updates icon name types.

methods.name: generateIconFiles
methods.description: Main function to generate SVG sprite and icon name TypeScript file if icons are outdated.

methods.name: iconName
methods.description: Converts SVG filename to icon name by removing the extension.

methods.name: generateSvgSprite
methods.description: Creates a combined SVG sprite with symbols for all icons.

methods.name: writeIfChanged
methods.description: Writes new content to a file only if it differs from current content, then formats the file.
